events.name: European Nuclear Education Network
events.description: Founding of ENEN as an institutional framework for European nuclear education and the academic-industrial workforce pipeline.

events.name: Fukushima Daiichi accident
events.description: Major nuclear accident; broad reorganisation of reactor-physics, safety, and Generation-IV research communities; documented Gen IV pullback.

events.name: NUGENIA association
events.description: Founding of the NUGENIA technical association covering Gen II and Gen III reactor research and safety.

events.name: Paris Agreement enters into force
events.description: Global climate agreement; nuclear positioning within low-carbon energy strategy.

events.name: European Green Deal
events.description: EU framework for climate neutrality by 2050; nuclear initially ambiguous in the taxonomy, then included as transitional activity.

events.name: Russia–Ukraine war
events.description: European energy-security pivot; sanctions on Rosatom fuel supply; accelerated SMR programmes and renewed national new-build commitments.

events.name: Net-Zero Industry Act
events.description: EU industrial-policy framework including advanced nuclear technologies among strategic net-zero technologies.
